responses.text: {Small Fry} Hey, hey! Look who has the hot hands?{Friendly} Here, have something special on the house.
{Big Winner} Looks like someone is on a roll. {Sing-song} Luck be a lady tonight. Here's a little something from the Family.
{Whale} You keep on spending money in here.{Mock Jocking} You gotta give us a chance to win something back. Here's something nice for you.
{Banned} Ok, that's that. No more games for you. Go rob the Tops. You're done here.
Have some drinks, talk to some dancers but you are done at my tables.
